plain_text:
Jack Oakie appears in 5 recordings across 4 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1936 to 1945. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Jack Oakie most often in Screen Guild Theater, Command Performance, Lux Radio Theatre, and Old Gold Comedy Theater.
